name: 极简几何
prefix: Bauhaus-inspired minimal geometric illustration, everything constructed from bold circles, semicircles, rectangles, triangles and straight lines, crisp hard edges, flat solid colors, no gradients, clean diagram-like clarity, limited palette of navy, sky blue, coral red and off-white,
characters: stylized figures built from geometric shapes: a circle head without facial details, a trapezoid torso, rectangle limbs, clothes in one solid color block each,
suffix: plain off-white background, subject placed on the right half, generous empty space on the left half, balanced modern poster composition, wordless picture: every paper, sign, label and screen is blank plain color, no text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark
negative: text, letters, numbers, words, watermark, logo, photo, realistic, 3d render, complex background, clutter, painterly texture, deformed hands, extra fingers
note: 画风包：只管怎么画；画面内容来自分镜的画面描述。设计见 AREC spec/illustrated-explainer.md §2.2。
